veranderings.blok: Die pad tot by die verkeerslig
veranderings.rede: After 'Die lig staan', the trailing 'aan' can be read as the separable verb 'aanstaan' (the light is switched on); dropping it removes that reading, keeps the protected 'Die lig staan' and keeps the meaning.

veranderings.blok: Die pad tot by die verkeerslig
veranderings.rede: 'Duur' is the standard verb for time taken; 'vat' is colloquial and is used three times in three sentences here.

veranderings.blok: Die pad tot by die verkeerslig
veranderings.voor: Die verkeerslig vat elke oggend lank om te verander.
veranderings.na: Die verkeerslig neem elke oggend lank om te verander.
veranderings.rede: 'Neem lank om te' is the standard form; it also avoids a second colloquial 'vat' straight after the previous sentence.
